answer: Sybils must pay the full compute and stake per fake identity, so a thousand-account fable collapses under cumulative cost while honest participants amortize it. One concrete mechanism: each agent must solve a rotating proof-of-work cipher tied to its reputation slot before joining, and stake tokens locked in a shared harbor contract. Peer attestation then flags clusters sharing keys, slashing their stake. In practice, qwe0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
